resources.string: Deep mode
Also filter Chrome, WebView and apps that run their own DNS. Uses your device\'s VPN slot.
Deep mode
Shows that the Deep-mode DNS tunnel is running, and warns if it stops.
Deep mode is on
Filtering DNS for every app, including Chrome. This uses your device\'s VPN slot, so no other VPN can run at the same time.

Turn off
Deep mode switched itself off
It failed three times in ten minutes, so it stopped to keep your connection working: %1$s. The rest of Nullroute is unaffected. You can turn Deep mode back on from the app.
Deep mode could not start
%1$s. Nothing has changed on your device and Nullroute\'s other filtering is unaffected. Try again once the problem is resolved.
Deep mode stopped
Another app took the VPN slot. Only one VPN can run at a time, so Deep mode is off until you turn it on again. Nullroute\'s other filtering is unaffected.
Turn on Deep mode?

Deep mode routes only DNS lookups through Nullroute, using your device's VPN slot. While it is on, no other VPN app can run.

It adds filtering for Chrome, WebView and other apps that run their own DNS resolver — the ones the system filter cannot see.

It still cannot block: ads served from the same domain as the content (YouTube, Instagram, Spotify), apps that use their own encrypted DNS with built-in addresses, or anything at all while another VPN holds the slot.

No resolver filter was found on this device, so Deep mode is on by default — it is the only layer that can filter here.
The resolver filter is handling every app that uses Android\'s system resolver, so Deep mode is off by default. Turn it on to also cover Chrome and WebView.

Private DNS is set to a specific provider, so system lookups go straight to it and Deep mode cannot see them. Nullroute will not change that setting for you — switch Private DNS to Automatic or Off if you want Deep mode to filter those lookups.
Deep mode cannot block in-app encrypted DNS that uses built-in addresses, ads served from the same domain as the content, or anything while another VPN is connected.
